assay: bulk RNA-seq (SMARTer Stranded Total RNA-Seq Pico v2) of FACS-sorted cardiac endothelial cells (CD31+CD140a-CD45-Ter119-DAPI-), NextSeq 550 single-end
primary_estimand: Effect of 6-week progressive treadmill exercise training vs sedentary on the cardiac endothelial-cell transcriptome in young adult (10-week-old at start) male C57BL/6J mice
planned_contrasts: EXE vs SED (S2.1.p1, FIG2A; DEG count shown only in the MA-plot image, not in text)
other_experiments_in_series: Aged vs Young, HFD vs Chow, TAC 2wk vs Sham, TAC 7wk vs Sham (each with its own control; not exercise; out of scope)
sample_inclusion: SED1-3 (n=3) and EXE1-3 (n=3) male mice; FIG2 legend N=3-4 male mice/group
repeated_measure_unit: none (independent animals, one EC sample per mouse)
normalization: DESeq2 size factors on HTSeq raw counts (S4.15.p1)
paper_method: DESeq2 (Chipster v3.12.2) two-group, ~ group, Wald test, BH FDR (S4.15.p1)
paper_results: Exercise affected fewer genes than the risk factors (S2.1.p2, S3.p2). Serpinh1, Vwa1, Mest and Fhl3 significantly DOWN-regulated by exercise (S2.3.p1, FIG4A-C). PANTHER ORA of up/down genes (S2.2.p1, S4.16.p1).
